brand_identity.concept: Cinematic, theatrical, luxury. Moulin Rouge meets fine dining.

headings.usage: H1-H6, large stylistic quotes, marquee text. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for large sizes.

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation links, buttons, small labels. Use tracking-widest for uppercase labels.

arabic.rules: When RTL is active, use native system fonts, increase line height (leading-loose), ensure all flex/grid layouts reverse automatically via Tailwind rtl: prefix or dir='rtl' attribute.

visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom gold cursor: A small dot (bg-[#C9A84C]) that tracks the mouse. On hover over clickable elements, it expands in size and uses mix-blend-difference.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay globally (mix-blend-overlay opacity 5%) to kill digital flatness and enhance the cinematic feel.
visual_enhancers.particles: Floating gold and red particles in the Hero section (using framer-motion absolute divs with varying animation durations and scales).

motion.global: Lenis smooth scrolling is mandatory for momentum. Framer motion for all reveals.
motion.hero_reveal: Curtain Opening: Two `bg-[#1A0000]` overlays split from the center to left/right on load (duration 1.5s, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1]). Afterwards, the LÀ·BA title reveals line-by-line masked (staggered y: 100% to 0).
motion.scroll_reveals: Sections fade in and translate up (y: 40) using whileInView with viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-100px' }}.

layouts.container: Max-width typically 1440px with generous p-6 md:p-12 lg:p-24 padding.
layouts.menu_split: lg:grid lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12. Left col-span-5 has `sticky top-32` image container. Right col-span-7 has the scrollable menu list.
layouts.gallery_masonry: columns-1 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-6. Images use break-inside-avoid.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular. Primary: `bg-[#C9A84C] text-[#1A0000] font-medium hover:bg-white transition-colors`. Secondary: `border border-[#C9A84C] text-[#C9A84C] hover:bg-[#C9A84C] hover:text-[#1A0000]`.
components.cards: Experience cards: `bg-[#1A0000] border border-[#8B0000] hover:border-[#C9A84C] transition-all p-8 rounded-none md:rounded-lg`.
components.inputs: Minimalist: `bg-transparent border-b border-[#C9A84C]/50 text-white placeholder-white/50 focus:border-[#C9A84C] focus:outline-none py-3`.

sections.name: Header & Nav
sections.details: Sticky top-0 z-40. `backdrop-blur-md bg-[#1A0000]/80`. Solid gold bottom border 1px. Logo center, Links left/right. RTL toggle. Floating WhatsApp button fixed bottom-right z-50.

sections.name: Hero
sections.details: Min-h-screen relative. Background: `/images/hero-dining.jpg` with `bg-black/40` overlay. Title LÀ·BA in center. Subtitle 'Art of Dining'. Curtain split reveal on load. Two CTAs (Menu, Reserve). Floating particles.

sections.name: Marquee
sections.details: Auto-scrolling. Text: 'LÀ·BA RIYADH — ART OF DINING — 4.3★ RATING — OPEN UNTIL 3AM — '. Large italic serif `text-6xl md:text-8xl` text-[#C9A84C] opacity-30.

sections.name: Story & Stats
sections.details: Bento grid or asymmetrical layout. 3 stats (4.3★, 800+ reviews, Daily 12PM–3AM) over deep red background. Image: `/images/interior-main.jpg`.

sections.name: Menu
sections.details: 8 Tabs (Coffee, Sliders & Burgers, Desserts, Drinks, Seafood, Pizza, Restaurant, Breakfast). Split layout. The sticky image changes smoothly when a new tab is clicked. Hovering over menu items shifts the image scale slightly.

sections.name: Experience
sections.details: 6 cards (Live Entertainment, Shisha Lounge, Signature Mocktails, Iconic Architecture, 4.3 Stars, Open Until 3AM). Each card has a subtle gold icon/accent and muted text description.

sections.name: About Highlight
sections.details: Full-width image of `/images/stage.jpg` with a parallax effect. Gold offset frame layout (border box displaced from the image). Text overlay 'Where every meal is a performance'.

sections.name: Gallery
sections.details: Masonry grid using `/images/arch-neon.jpg`, `/images/exterior-night.jpg`, and other food images. Implement a simple lightbox on click.

sections.name: Reservation
sections.details: Form collecting First/Last Name, Phone, Guests, Date, Time, Requests. Submission generates a WhatsApp `wa.me/966582266333` link with pre-filled text and logically saves to a DB (simulated or API route).

sections.name: Footer
sections.details: Simple, elegant. Address: Prince Abdulaziz St, As Sulimaniyah, Riyadh. Contact info, social links (@la.ba.ksa). Text 'Designed by MYFRIX' at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install `framer-motion`, `@studio-freight/lenis`, `lucide-react`, `react-fast-marquee`. Import Google Fonts Cormorant Garamond & Montserrat. Write code in .jsx/.js files instead of .tsx since this is a JS project.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Ensure this is a single page application with smooth scrolling anchor links.
instructions_to_main_agent.rtl: Implement a simple toggle in the header that switches the HTML `dir` attribute between `ltr` and `rtl`. Ensure layout flex directions flip gracefully.
instructions_to_main_agent.css: Configure Tailwind config with the custom colors: `primary: '#8B0000'`, `secondary: '#1A0000'`, `accent: '#C9A84C'`. Set the body background to `secondary` (#1A0000).
instructions_to_main_agent.whatsapp_integration: The reservation form submit should construct a URL like `https://wa.me/966582266333?text=New%20Reservation...` and open it in a new tab.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns to preserve text contrast.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements for testing.
Ensure the hero curtain animation runs immediately upon component mount.
Do not center-align body text; reserve centering for headings and hero moments.
Never use generic default fonts; stick strictly to Cormorant Garamond and Montserrat.
Apply generous padding (p-12, p-24) to establish a luxury, uncrowded feel.
Include hover transitions on all interactive elements (links, buttons, form fields).
Maintain the strict Red (#8B0000 / #1A0000) and Gold (#C9A84C) color palette. Do not inject other brand colors.
